balls.text: edged and the innings end on a note that it had how it started in the first few overs, a drop! Outside the off-stump, went for a drive, gets the outside edge, and Uthappa dives to his right, but puts it down.
pitched right up to the batsman, punched to the off side for a single
outside the off stump, short of good length, he smacks it to wide long-off, Ganguly gave a chase from extra-cover, Kartik from long-off, who gets his foot down in time and prevents the four
tries to slog it away, gets an outside edge and goes to deep cover for a single
angling away from the batsman, pitched right up to the bat and he goes for an expansive shot, lands in no-man's land behind the bowler
pitched up, outside the off stump, driven to long-off and they are able to come back for a second

gone, caught by Ganguly at mid-off! The Eden Gardens is on their feet, Ganguly has taken a good catch, steepler, and Shukla is gone, attempting to tonk it away over long-off, gets only the bottom of the bat and it goes higher but not long enough.
shorter yet again and he gives it all, the pull takes it away only to deep mid-wicket for a single
slower one, and he swings it away, misses yet again, the pitch is not getting easier.
low full-toss, outside the off-stump and missed by the batsman
Tries to pluck it right at the edge of the fence again and this time Smith fails to parry it back! Short ball and he had smashed it away, almost a catch!
gone, caught at long-on, tried to go over the fence with a shot he likes to play, the swing over long-on, but the timing goes awry and it well caught by Smith who comes in and grabs it.

dropped! Bhuvneshwar Kumar has spilled what seemed to be a difficult catch in the end but it looks like he misjudged it at the sweeper region, came in late. All this after Das tried to cut the ball away but did not find the fence.
swings hard, misses, bit of a reverse swing away?
poor delivery off the Free Hit, wide outside the off-stump, full-toss too.
good delivery, but a no-ball! Outside the off stump, slower one, the batsmen are failing to make any pace off their own and the ball's not coming on after pitching.
outside the off stump, tries to punch it through the covers, misses the shot as the ball keeps a tad low.
short and pulled well, but goes to the deep square-leg fielder for a single.
short of length yet again, clipped away to fine-leg for another single
short of length, punched to deep square-leg for a single
slower one, punched through the covers for a single, only 2 from the over.

Oooh! run-out missed! Played it to the off side, wanted to go for a quick single, but Das did not, Pathan was almost halfway down the pitch and the fielder had ample of time to throw it down, but missed
shorter, nudged to the leg side for a single
slower, rolls his fingers over the ball, shorter and punched back to the bowler. It is now showing its true colours, the pitch.
bouncer again, goes over the batsman, wide not called, so that it two dots now.
shot back and dropped? Short, he pulled it back to the bowler, who was on his follow-through and did not get too much of a hand there.
fullish, driven to long-on for a single
full-toss, punched it to the long-off fielder for a run
big shout, for lbw, slower ball again and beats the bat yet again, there was an appeal for lbw, in line but the height could have been an issue
on the front foot, pushed to the off side

bowled him! Slower ball and totally deceived him! Rolls the fingers over the ball, turns into the batsman and Kallis was walking into the stroke, missed the ball totally and the bails are on the ground.
short of good length, nudged away to fine-leg for a single
on the pads, played away neatly to the leg-side for a single
on the front foot, defended back
down the leg side for another wide

pitched up and Six. No! It is not! Yusuf swung hard and launched the ball towards wide long-on, and it was well on its way over the boundary. Smith, however, sprinted to his right from long-on and then threw himself full length to intercept the ball on the full. He actually caught the ball in mid air and because he was going over the boundary, managed to fling it back into play, saving four runs
defended off the front foot, Kartik runs to his right and fields and there is no run.
pitched up, flighted and driven to long-off for a single
short of length, driven to long-on for a single
short of good length, punched to the short mid-wicket fielder.
on the middle, slower, driven back to the bowler.

gone, lbw! McCullum has probably inside-edged it to his back-pad and that is why he is looking unhappy, but he was trying the paddle sweep and missed it. Will need the replays to confirm whether there was an edge on that one.
reverse-swept and it is a good thing they did not go for the single because it went very quickly to the short third-man fielder.
pitched right up, does not get any power, inside edge into his thigh pad
defended on the front foot, and they are off for a quick single. The ball just dropped in front of him and McCullum called him over for a run
outside the off stump, pushed to the off side and it is straight to the fielder. A much better over for Pune.
outside the leg stump, nudged away to the short fine-leg and that should have not been a single, but Dindad misfields that. Pathan's away
on the back foot, tries to run it through the slips, and there is a slip in places, misses the edge
full-toss and caught at long-off! Finally a wicket for the Pune Warriors, went down the pitch and tried to hit it over long-off, does not get too much power in that shot and it is easily taken.
too short, cut away to the left of deep cover and they get only a single, was well fielded by Mathews
outside the off stump, flighted, goes down to the pitch of the ball and drives to long-on
slower, shorter and pulled away to deep square-leg for a single
down the track and smacked it over to deep square-leg for a single
pitched up, right under the bat, tries to drive but goes to short cover where the fielder dives in front and fields, there is a loud, loud cheer, which tells me it is Ganguly there.
outside the off stump, played away to the off side, did not come on to the bat
short of good length, punched through mid-wicket and they are off for a single

outside the off stump, cut away, beats the point fielder and they come back for the second. The throw came in flat and the batsman was only slightly in when Uthappa dislodged the bails. Third umpire calls it not-out
slower one, over the extra-cover for a couple of runs, bit of misfield from Mathews at the fence.
short of a good length, pushed to the short cover fielder
short ball, bouncer, trying to pull it away but misses the shot, goes through to the keeper
inside edge and that has gone away for a four, beats the middle of the bat and the leg stump.
driven to long-on and that brings up the 100-run stand for the first wicket. This is only the third 100-run opening stand for the season.
on the middle stump, clipped away to the mid-wicket region for a couple. Oh, and it is one-run short from Gambhir.
pitched on middle, punched to the leg side for a single.
he attempts a reverse sweep now, Mathews is not a slow bowler, but that was a full-toss and that could have gone to the fence, does not get it off the middle
smashed trough the covers for four, between deep cover and long-off.
slower, outside the off stump, driven through the covers for a single to deep cover
pitched up, driven back to the bowler, does well to get some body on it and they still get a single
late cuts it away to the third-man fielder for a single
driven over the bowler for a single, another seven-run over from Clarke.
dropped, Dinda has dropped the easiest catch you will see on a cricket field. And I don't lie. Seriously, sweep attempted, top-edge and the ball lobbed to Dinda.
on the front foot, defended back to the bowler
short, down the leg side, wanted to pull it away, goes to short fine-leg
swept away hard and despite a dive by Bhuvneshwar Kumar at fine-leg, he is only able to deflect it away for a four
goes down the pitch, tapped away to long-on for a single
late dab to the third-man fielder and he has a single off that last delivery
outside the off, short of length, punched down the ground for a single.
opens the face of the bat to the third-man for a single
on his pads, flicked away between deep square-leg and fine-leg for a couple of runs
on his pads, flicked away to the deep square-leg fielder
outside the off stump, punched back to mid-off
and he begins from where the Warriors had left off, a wide down the leg-side.
shimmy down the pitch, places it in that region between long-on and deep mid-wicket and that is a four.
outside the off stump, cuts it late, straight to point
on the back foot, pushed through the leg side for a single to mid-wicket
full-toss, driven to long-on for a single.
shorter, goes on the back foot, drives to long-on for a single
on the front foot, defended on the on-side
another down the leg side and that is another four, this isn't first-class level bowling by any stretch, struggling with the left-right combination and drifting it down the pads of both the batsmen.
shot, six! That is one of Gambhir's favourite stroke, he goes a couple of steps down the pitch and slams it over mid-wicket for a six!
punched off the back foot to mid-off for a single
outside edge and four for McCullum, the run-rate's at 10 and I wouldn't believe if I told myself that this is a slow pitch.
on the middle stump, coming into the batsman, opens the face of the bat, taps it away to the third-man fielder
outside edge, tries to drive it away, does not go where he wants it to go, to the right of third-man and they are off for a second
down the leg side and the poor start continues, it is another wide, the swing is not helping.
cut and fielded well by the point fielder, that was rushing away to the fence, dived to his left to save it. 17 from the over anyway.
on his pads, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
goes down the track and thwack! Over long-on for a six! This is quickly becoming a very dangerous start
very poor bowling from the Warriors here, this swung a bit into the bat, drifted down the leg side and gets some pad on the way to the fine-leg fence
slower and tries to heave it over the mid-wicket region, gets no timing and it stops just to the left of the mid-on fielder
crunched through the extra-cover for four! Pitched up to the bat and the ball almost stopped after pitched but Gambhir goes with the stroke and it goes over the fielder
finally a end of a long over, goes down the track to play it, the ball was jagging in and the batsman only pushes it the on-side.
big shout for an lbw, he has been getting them to swing both ways, this time angling in and hits the pads, but the ump thinks it is going down

outside the off stump, slower one, tapped away to the off and it goes on the bounce to the keeper. The batsmen take a single, Uthappa threw it to the non-strikers, hits the stumps with the batsman well in
outside the off stump, short of length, punched to the cover fielder, straight to Manish Pandey who misfields and they can take one
on the middle stump, opened the face of the bat, dabbed away to third-man for a single
outside the off stump and this is a wide on the off side, that is seven runs off wides this over already.
gets his line right, outside the off stump, tapped away to the off side
down the leg side again and this is collected well but it is a wide nevertheless.
down the leg side, a very poor delivery, it pitched outside the leg stump and swung away to the fence. Uthappa got a bit of hand but it goes for five wides.
goes on to the back foot, and cuts it away to the short third-man fielder for a single. Six off the over after the first ball had been reverse-swept to the fence.
a bit of a short ball, played on the back foot for a single to mid-wicket
defended back to the bowler off the front foot again
on the front foot, defended back to the bowler
pitched on middle, went for the forward defence and it gripped and turned away, beats the bat, hits the pad but a stifled appeal
reverse swept to the ball that was pitched up and it easily beats the short third-man fielder! This is a good start from the home team
short of a good length, nudged away to the mid-wicket region and they run well to get their second run. That was as stylish a nudge as you would see on a slow track
short ball and shot! Bouncer from Dinda, which is not such a bad idea on this track where the ball is not coming on and it has been hooked away for a six!
outside the off stump, tries to cut it away but the ball does not come on to the bat, bottom of the bat, goes to the third-man for a single
short of length, on the middle, defended on the back foot to the off side
outside the off stump, a bit of away movement, defended on the front foot to the off side.
crisply driven and fails to beat the extra-cover fielder. Pitched right up to the bat, outside the off stump and he will be disappointed not to find the gap
on his pads, floated up to the batsman, who dabs it gently to the leg side for a single
was on the back-foot before saw the ball pitched up, on-driven to the square-leg fielder for a single.
outside the off-stump, fullish, wanted to drive at it but did not come on too much
on the middle stump, fuller and defended to the off side
down the leg-side, slight turn away for a wide
poor, poor ball, that was longer and shorter than a usual long-hop and that has been pulled away to the fine-leg fence. Both fielders were inside the 30-yarder
on the off stump, a bit of drift away, pushed into the covers

full-toss from de Lange and he can only get it to short cover, that is five losses in a row for Pune. Gambhir looks very pumped after the win, mouthing off a few unmentionables as well in the process.
surprise bouncer, he goes for the pull and that takes the top-edge over the wicket-keeper for a four. Eight still needed for the win and they have one ball to go

full-toss and that has been caught brilliantly under pressure! The umpires have referred it to the third umpire and replays show that it has been caught rather well, Mathews took it well on the full and was drilled it back to long-on where Shukla picks up a beauty
full-pitcher yet again, drilled to mid-off and they can get only a single. 12 needed from 3.
pitched up, almost a yorker and that has been dug out rather well, drilled over extra-cover for a four! Excellent shot keeps Pune in the game.
slog attempted over mid-wicket but the pace does not allow him to time it too well, goes to the fielder for a single
pitched right up, wants to drive it but it goes back to him, what a spell, what a bowler!
pitched right up, chipped up and it goes over the bowler's head for a couple.
on his pads, tries to flick it away, it is turning away from the bat, and the leading edge goes to point.

gone, run-out? Tried the sweep, got it well in the middle and they easily get a single, but Mathews wanted a second, Parnell was a bit apprehensive of it and that costs him his wicket. Good throw from Shukla in the deep. Bill Bowden did not call for the third umpire, but it was close enough.
flighting the ball up and getting the ball to turn away from the batsman, missed it
on the middle stump, just moving away, tapped away to the off side for a single
slow, slow and another one slow, on the off-stump, short too, but he can only punch it to the covers for a run.
slower one, shorter and driven back to the bowler

gone, caught at mid-wicket! Shorter one, pulled away and had that hit the middle it would have gone the distance, but the problem was the lack of pace, he fails to get it where he would have wanted, loops up to deep mid-wicket for a single
driven to long-off off one pitched right up and they get a single

full-toss and Ganguly has hit it hard, but mistimed it, goes to long-off on a bounce, the bat's cracked I think and Ganguly's cross. Hits his bat hard with his gloves. Probably that is what cracked the bat.
gone for six! How did that happen! Shorter, slower and Ganguly pulled it straight, bit of a top-edge and it goes over long-on for a six
shorter from Narine, Ganguly was giving himself room, but in the end, can only punch it with a horizontal bat to long-on
goes on to the back foot, and wants to slog it away but he misses yet again. This is not easy.
full-toss, yorker-length, driven to long-on for a single
quicker on his pads, on-driven, to mid-wicket and he is off strike
was moving around in the crease, the ball was flighted and spun away from the batsman!
on the pads, clipped away to fine-leg for a single
on the leg stump, driven to the extra cover fielder and that will usher in the Time-Out
that slower one again, shorter as well, wanted to heave it away but does not get it from the middle and it goes to the deep mid-wicket fielder
again, slower from Bhatia, he pushes to the off side, wanted a single but sent back by Ganguly
full-toss, driven to long-off for a single
four, off the inside-edge, pulled away, or did he? It goes between his legs, through the short fine-leg for a four!
pushed to the off side and they are off for a single, Ganguly is not at his fleetest best but he is lucky the throw was off
goes on to the back foot and tries to drill it through the gap, but it goes on the first bounce to the extra-cover fielder. No run again!
pushed to the off side off the back foot but to the fielder
from round the wicket, outside the off stump, shorter and pushed to the off side for a single
flat six! Three in a row and Pune are right back into the game, slog-swept it away to deep mid-wicket area for a six! 26 from 15 for Mathews
goes down the track and that has been dispatched over long-on for the second six of the over, in a row! Pathan and Kolkata under a bit of a pressure...enough to make them think.
slogged away over mid-wicket for a six! Pathan jerked before he released the ball and Mathews still went through with that slog sweep!
goes for a heave, across the line, does not get his timing right, goes to mid-wicket for a single
tries to drill it over long-off, but goes on the bounce to the fielder
very slow, tapped it to the off side, they go for a single and there is an appeal for run-out. Ganguly was not stretching there but the wicket-keeper had to go low before dislodging the bails.
outside the leg stump, gives himself room and drives to long-off for a single
pitched up, a bit of a swing into him, driven to long-on for a single
gives himself room, cuts it real hard and it goes to the sweeper fielder for a single
down the leg-side, he got some bat there without which it would have been a wide, it goes to the short fine-leg fielder. Mathews wanted a single but Ganguly refuses yet again.
goes down the track and dabbed away to the square-leg region, Mathews wanted a run but Ganguly did not
on the middle stump, turning away down the leg side and that is a wide
outside the off stump,pushed into the covers and they are off for a quick one
outside the off stump and turning back into the batsman, cut away for a run. When Pathan gets so much turn...
was giving himself some room, he bowled it short, tried to cut it away, but can get it only to long-off for a single
quicker one, turning as well, almost a leading edge to the off side
pitched up and driven to long-off for a single
slower one, driven down the ground this time for only a single
outside the off stump, taking all the pace of the ball, punched to the off side and sent back by the non-striker
shorter, slower on the middle, punched to wide long-on for a single
slower one, bowled on his pads, nudged away for a single
on the stumps, punched to long-on for a single
this time he flicks it away wide of the bowler, towards mid-wicket and they take a single
pitched outside the leg and turned away from the bat, played away towards mid-on where the bowler rushes to stop him from taking the single
outside the off stump, pitched up, not too much turn and Ganguly almost lets it go
four more for Ganguly, an outside edge through where the second slip would have been and it rushes off to the fence. There is one slip in place but it went wider of him
and another viciously turning ball from leg to off and it squares him up, hits the back thigh pad and goes for a four through the slips!
big spin, going away from the batsman, beats it by a huge way, stumping appeal too.
goes on to the off side, works it away to the square-leg for a single, a much better over for all three, Kolkata, Ganguly and his fans.
from round the wicket, tries to bowl another bouncer, it goes over the head of the batsman, a very high wide. Few words too between the batsman and the bowler
gives room yet again and upper cuts it over the head of the wicket-keeper, short ball sent away to the fence! Two in two here!
Oooh, it was not timed too well, good length ball, freed the arms and hits it over mid-off, gets just enough to get the much-needed boundary
slower and a bouncer, he tried to cut it away, but misses it by a distance.
short of length, flicked it away to fine-leg for a single
good length, goes on to his back foot, the ball keeps a tad low, punched to the off side
outside the leg-stump, he wants to sweep it away, but the turn defeats that stroke yet again, lucky it does not hit his gloves and loop up!
quicker one, spinning away from the batsman, beaten again!
punched off the back foot to the off side where there is a silly point in place.
big turn yet again, and this time it is the conventional offie, a leg-spinner for the left-hander

loud appeal and given out lbw! Did that hit the bat? Yes it did, it was going away yet again, gets an inside edge on to his pads but the umpire has upheld the appeal and that is the end of Smith...just when I thought he was doing well.
straight away a leg-spinner, quicker as well and beaten!
short of length, on the middle, pushed to fine-leg and they are away for another single. Smith's doing it well here so far, it is the rest who need to back him here
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and punches to third-man for a single
short, pulled, caught! That was a quicker one, the batsman failed to get enough bat on it, goes to mid-wicket where the fielder back-pedals to take a good catch
slowly nudged it away to square-leg for a single, length ball, not really coming on to the bat
outside the off stump, Manhas has cut it away to the left of point, well fielder by the third-man restricted to one.
on his pads, worked away to fine-leg for a single
outside the off stump, pushed to the off side and that is the end of an excellent spell from Abdulla.
pitched right up, driven to mid-wicket and they are off for a single
gone, caught at long-off! He tries to hit over long-off, but fails miserably to get the timing, the ball spoons up and the fielder comes in to take a decent catch
goes for a cut, spin there and it beats the middle of the bat, loops over the in-field on the off side
short of length, quietly pushed away to the deep mid-wicket for a couple, really good running
outside the off stump, pushed to the covers for a quick single
tries the pickup shot over the in-field but it only goes on the bounce to the short mid-wicket fielder
slower ball, yorker length, takes it on the full and drives to mid-on for a single
pitched right up yet again, drilled through the in-field and that is gone for four!
driven away and that is fielded well by Tiwary again, but it allows the batsman a Free Hit!
good length, outside the off stump, defends on the front foot, rush off quickly for a single
short of length, nudged away to mid-wicket for a quick single, there was another shy at the stumps and Kallis misses
outside the off stump, cut away and that is brilliantly fielded by Tiwary at point to his right, has a shy at the stumps but misses and they get an overthrow
floated up to the bat, nudged away to the leg side for a single
shorter ball, cut away but straight to the fielder.
short ball and he has pulled away through wide mid-on for a four
short of length, pushed to mid-on for a single
outside the off stump, pushed to the covers, who came rushing in and preventing the single
on the pads, shorter, driven to mid-wicket for a single
outside the off stump and that is left alone by the batsman, six runs off the over and a wicket.
short of good length, punched back to the bowler off the back foot
caught in the covers! It was driven on the up, and de Lange is a bowler who gets a bit of bounce, it floated in the air for the fielder in the covers for a simple catch.
outside the off stump, on the length, did not move his feet anywhere, gets an inside edge and it goes to short fine-leg
worked away off his pads to deep square-leg for a single
one bounce four over wide long-on. de Lange pitched that one up to the bat, Uthappa chipped it over the in-field and that has almost gone all the way
loud, loud lbw appeal to this reverse sweep, given not-out by the umpire! It was pitching in line with stumps, he tried to reverse sweep it and it hit the pads, why wasn't that out?
wants to go down the track, but he fires it quickly into the pads, misses
tries to cut it from the stumps, but there is no pace on the ball, and the bounce isn't too much either
shorter, down the leg-side, Uthappa tried to pull it away, missed and it is a wide
on the pads, tries to work away to the leg-side, goes for a quick single, bit of a doubt but they make it in the end, the throw hit the stumps at the non-striker's end direct
gives himself some room, goes to the leg-stump and drives it to long-off for a single
uses his feet, goes down the pitch, pushes it back to the bowler
slower one, pitched up to the bat, defended on the front foot but to the covers
cut away through point and that has rushed away for a four! Short, bit wide and it beats the point fielder easily.
pitches it a little up this time, Pandey is a bit stuck on his back-foot and he pushes it to the covers
opens the face of the bat to some good pace and bounce, short of good length, to third-man for a single
another one with that extravagant bounce but it is down the leg side for another wide!
outside the off stump, and good length ball, bounces more than what he expected, on to the back foot, punched to third-man for a single
pace and bounce yet again, but down the leg-side and that is a wide
bowled him, through him! Hit the pads, flicks the bails and Clarke's on his way. Short of good length and played on the back-foot, almost surprised him for pace and a bit of bounce too!
shimmies down the track, on-drives to square-leg and they take a single. Good start by the Warriors.
off the front foot, pushed to the off side and they take a quick single
late, late cut, and that turns out to be an excellent shot, cut from the stumps and delays the stroke to hit it in the gap
nudged away to the right of mid-on, misfield from Rajat Bhatia and they take a second
goes down the pitch and scooped up over mid-on for a couple, the long-off comes in and fields
on the off stump, defended by Uthappa on to the off side
